test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘COFFEE’ is written as ‘FTKKJH’ and ‘EXPERT’ is written as ‘HCUJWW’. How will ‘FRENCH’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘COFFEE’ is written as ‘FTKKJH’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e875ed9260df3d0ac8f260c073a66af0138890bf50a64d20fc18fb2b1019713e.png] 

For, ‘EXPERT’ is written as ‘HCUJWW’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d31d5183f6be3036f474dc4f1a3fb8965367022d69d826a5a6504fccb40cdc49.png] 

Similarly, for ‘FRENCH’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2883ed414690b5b169a570c6a04d88495a56eefdb0afb8669fa085defcb160d8.png] 

So,** ‘FRENCH’** will be written as **'IWJSHK'**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
